visuals.title: Warm, moist sites
visuals.text: Skin folds, oral mucosa and vaginal mucosa are warm and moist, so Candida proliferates there.

glossary.Immunocompromised: Having a weakened immune system, for example from HIV, chemotherapy or steroids.
glossary.Immunosuppression: Reduced activity of the immune system, from disease or drugs.
glossary.Immunodeficiency: A defect in the immune system that leaves a person prone to infection.
glossary.Mucosa: The moist lining of body cavities such as the mouth, oesophagus and vagina.
glossary.Plaques: Raised, flat-topped patches on skin or mucosa.
glossary.Cottage cheese: Describes the thick, white, lumpy discharge typical of vaginal thrush.
glossary.Vulval: Relating to the vulva, the external female genitalia.
glossary.Oropharynx: The part of the throat behind the mouth.
glossary.Oral candidiasis: Candida infection of the mouth, causing white plaques that scrape off.
glossary.Oesophageal candidiasis: Candida infection of the oesophagus, causing painful swallowing; an AIDS-defining illness.
glossary.HIV: Human immunodeficiency virus, which destroys CD4 T cells and weakens immunity.
glossary.AIDS: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome: the late stage of HIV infection with opportunistic infections.
glossary.Inhaled corticosteroid: A steroid inhaler used in asthma and COPD, such as beclometasone; it can cause oral thrush.
glossary.Microscopy: Looking at a sample under a microscope, here to see yeast cells.
glossary.Vaginal swab: A sample taken from the vagina with a swab for microscopy or culture.
glossary.Topical: Applied directly to the skin or mucosa.
glossary.Antifungal: A drug that kills or stops the growth of fungi.
glossary.Suspension: A liquid medicine with drug particles dispersed in it, shaken before use.
glossary.Cytochrome P450: A family of enzymes; azoles block the fungal version needed to make ergosterol.
glossary.Proliferation: Rapid multiplication of cells or organisms.
glossary.Yeast: A single-celled fungus; Candida grows as yeast that reproduces by budding.
glossary.Recurrent vaginal candidiasis: Four or more episodes of vaginal thrush in a year.
glossary.Broad-spectrum antibiotics: Antibiotics that kill many types of bacteria, including the protective normal flora.
